newsitem.title: FRANCE: BASKETBALL-PANATHINAIKOS TAKE REVENGE WITH AWAY WIN.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-PANATHINAIKOS TAKE REVENGE WITH AWAY WIN.

text.p: European champions Panathinaikos took revenge over French side Villeurbanne by beating them 80-74 in a EuroLeague match on Wednesday.
Greek club Panathinaikos, who were beaten 72-66 by Villeurbanne in Athens, led from start to finish.
Inspired by Lithuanian Frangiskos Alvertis, who went on to score 25 points, the Greeks built a 13-point lead by halftime.
The French club fought back but were always up against it despite a great performance by American Delaney Rudd, the match's top scorer with 27 points.
Panathinaikos's victory took them to the top of group C. They have 14 points compared to Villeurbanne's 13.
